content: Task ledger update: Hermes Discord work-stream continuation command deployed. Added /continue to the Annunimas Discord operating-room surface. It records annunimas.hermes.work_stream_continuation_request.v1 entries in data/hermes/work_stream_continuations.jsonl and preserves the boundary that continuation does not approve execution or close tasks. Refreshed the canonical plan, runbook, and activation check so the full command set /plans, /tasks, /task, /review, /continue, /council, /gateway is verified. Built release and restarted annunimas-hermes-discord.service after approval; service is active and reconnected as Annunimas_CEO. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-cli -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes_agent_gateway_activation_check -- --nocapture; cargo run -p annunimas-cli -- utility hermes-agent-gateway-activation-check reports ready_for_live_gateway/live_ready=true/operating_room_surface.ready=true.
